## Description

High-voltage input to a regulated 5 V (TPSM365R6V5, two 22 uF output capacitors) step-down supply: TI TPSM365R6V5RDNR fixed-output 600 mA buck module, FB tied to VOUT, MODE/SYNC tied to VCC (forced PWM), PGOOD pulled up to VOUT through 10k. Ports VIN, VOUT, PGOOD, GND. Output voltage and capacitor ratings judged from the datasheet facts at publication (release.json); hardware validation pending. BUCK profile. VIN 3.6 V to 65 V (facts, recommended operating); the block's input capacitors are 100 V 1206 parts and its VIN copper is block-local (PWR_HV_LOCAL), so the board's power entry carries its own class. 600 mA output; the module integrates the inductor; VCC bypass and the 100 nF high-frequency input bypass are the block's. PGOOD is the module's open-drain window-comparator output (rising at about 107 %, falling at about 94 % of the set point); the block pulls it up as its description says. Fixed variants: FB is tied to VOUT and pin 11 is MODE/SYNC, tied to VCC in this block (forced PWM); PGOOD is pulled up to the block's own output, so its high level is VOUT

## Operating Notes

- Signal path: VIN (3.6 to 65 V after start-up, UVLO rising 3.4 V typical) enters VIN (pin 3) and EN (pin 2, tied to VIN, so the module runs whenever input is present); the integrated-inductor module delivers VOUT (pin 4), 600 mA maximum; FB/BIAS (pin 9) is tied to VOUT for the fixed output; GND is pin 10.
- Variants (family.json): 5v fits U13001 = OW-PWR-TPSM365R6V5RDNR with both 22 uF output capacitors; 3v3 fits OW-PWR-TPSM365R6V3RDNR and leaves C13007 unpopulated. One schematic and one copper; the publisher writes each variant's part and DNP into its block and judges the output voltage and capacitor ratings from the facts (release.json). Output accuracy is +/-1.5 % in forced PWM (5 V facts).
- MODE/SYNC (pin 11) is tied to VCC (the internal LDO output, pin 8, bypassed by C13005 1 uF), which selects forced PWM. BOOT (pin 7) is left open and the two SW pins (5, 6) are tied only to each other, as the block was drawn and built: the module integrates its inductor and nothing external connects there.
- PGOOD (pin 1) is the module's open-drain window comparator: high once VOUT is inside the window (rising at about 107 %, falling at about 94 % of the set point, 25 us deglitch, about 2 ms delay after regulation), pulled up to VOUT by R13001 (10 k), so its high level is the output voltage itself (5 V or 3.3 V) and a 3.3 V host reads the 5 V variant's PGOOD only through a 5 V-tolerant input.
- Bypass: three 1 uF 100 V 1206 capacitors (C13001 to C13003) and a 100 nF 0603 (C13004) at VIN; the 22 uF output capacitors sit at about 50 % (5 V) and 33 % (3.3 V) of their rating, inside the family's 0.6 planning fraction. Current limits from the facts: high-side short-circuit 1 A typical, low-side 0.7 A typical.
- The placing board provides the VIN entry on its own class (the block's PWR_HV_LOCAL copper is block-local), a load of at most 600 mA, its own name for the VOUT net (the port is VOUT because the variant sets the voltage) and the thermal path: RthJA 56.3 C/W on a JEDEC 4-layer board, so give the module's pad a ground pour and vias.

## Placement and Routing

### Buck module and output capacitors

`U13001`, `C13006`, `C13007`, `C13001`, `C13002`, `C13003`, `C13004`, `C13005`, `R13001`

U13001 converts VIN to the fixed VOUT; C13006 and C13007 (22 uF) hold the output. C13007 is unpopulated on the 3v3 variant. Three 1 uF 100 V capacitors and a 100 nF high-frequency bypass across VIN to GND at the module's input. C13005 (1 uF) bypasses the internal LDO output VCC (pin 8), which also sets MODE/SYNC to forced PWM. R13001 (10 k) pulls the open-drain PGOOD (pin 1) up to VOUT.

- Place: Place C13006 and C13007 at VOUT (pin 4) with their GND ends at pin 10; keep the output loop short and on one layer.
- Place: Place C13004 (100 nF) closest to VIN (pin 3) and GND (pin 10), the 1 uF parts beside it; the input current loop is the noisiest on the block.
- Place: Place C13005 at pin 8 with a short return to pin 10.
- Place: Anywhere between VOUT and the PGOOD port; a low-current node.
- Route: VOUT is block-local copper (PWR_5V_LOCAL); the board names and classes the net on its side of the sheet pin.
- Route: Wide, short VIN copper from the capacitors into pin 3; no via between C13004 and the module if the layer allows it.
- Route: VCC stays inside the block; nothing else loads it.
- Route: PGOOD is a logic flag on the Default class; its high level equals VOUT.
